item.title: AIM movers: Time Finance recommends bid and Tertiary Minerals discovery
item.summary: Coal mine developer GCM Resources (LON: GCM) says recent Bangladesh government statements are positive, and the government is finalising its national energy mix policy with coal likely to be a part of the mix. The share price jumped 107.7% to 8.1p.
